transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you here today?

I'm... well, I was told to come in. It's work. I'm a cashier, and... I guess I've been doing things at the register. 

Like... sometimes I just tap the scanner. In a pattern. Or I'll just stop. My hand will be over the cash drawer and I just... freeze. People are waiting, but I can't... I just stay like that. 

They wrote me up for it last week. So... that's why I'm here.
Do you feel like you have to do these actions a certain way or in a certain pattern, or do they just happen without you meaning to?
I don't... I'm not really sure. I don't plan it out. It just... happens, I guess. I don't really know why.
When you find yourself doing these things at work, like tapping the scanner or freezing, do you feel like you have to do them to stop something bad from happening or to feel 'just right'?
No... not really. I don't feel like that. I just... I don't know. It just happens. I don't think about it like that.
Before you tap the scanner or freeze at the register, do you ever feel a strange sensation or urge in your body that makes you feel like you have to do it?
No... I don't think so. There's no... urge, or anything like that. I don't really feel anything before it happens. I'm just standing there and then... it just happens.
Have you ever had any movements or actions that you couldn’t control outside of work—like blinking, shrugging, or making sounds—especially when you're not at work?
No... I haven't noticed anything like that. Not at home, anyway. Just... no.
Have you noticed any difficulties with your daily activities, like problems focusing, remembering things, or feeling disorganized at home or in other situations outside of work?

I suppose... things have been a little difficult. They actually... they put me on a formal warning at work now. And outside of my shifts... I don't know, I just don't do much anymore. I haven't really been keeping up with friends... or calling my family. I used to go kayaking, but... I stopped making plans for that. I just... haven't been keeping up with things the way I used to.
Have you ever had thoughts that come into your mind that you can’t control or get rid of, even if you try?
No... I don't really get anything like that. My thoughts are just... my own, I guess. Nothing gets stuck.
Have you ever noticed any sudden, brief movements — like a twitch or a jerk — when you're sitting still or relaxing, even if you're not at work?
No... I don't think so. I haven't noticed any twitches or anything. I usually just... sit quietly.
Have you ever found it hard to pay attention to details or stay focused on tasks, even when you wanted to?
No... not really. I can focus on things if I need to. I just... haven't really wanted to do much lately, like I said. But paying attention is... it's fine.
Have you ever felt driven to do something over and over again, even if you didn’t want to, because not doing it would bother you or feel wrong in some way?
No... I don't have urges like that. If I don't need to do something, I just... don't do it. There's nothing I have to repeat.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy, like kayaking or spending time with friends?

I guess... yeah. I mean, I still care about my wife and kids, obviously. I just... I don't seem to have the push anymore. To call my son at college, or... meet up with the kayak group. Even my little repair projects... I don't touch them. People ask me what's wrong and I... I mostly just shrug. I can't really find much to say.
Have you noticed that you're less motivated to start or finish things, even simple tasks, compared to how you used to be?

Yeah... like I was just saying. The push just isn't there anymore. Even for the simple stuff, like those repair projects I mentioned... they just sit there. I don't start them. I don't really know what else to tell you about it.
Have you noticed that things that used to bring you joy or satisfaction don’t seem to do that anymore, even when you do them?
I don't know... I guess so. Like I said, I just don't do much of anything right now. So I wouldn't really know if they... if they still feel good or not. I just don't do them.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days, even when there’s no clear reason for it?
No... not really. I wouldn't say I feel sad or depressed. I just... I don't really feel much of anything, to be honest. It's not sadness. I don't know.
Have you noticed that even when you do engage in activities, they don’t bring you the same sense of enjoyment or satisfaction they used to, even slightly?
I... I thought I just answered that. Like I said, I don't really do much of anything anymore. So... I don't know. I can't really say.
Have you noticed that you’re not only less motivated at work and with hobbies, but also in other parts of your life, like personal goals, daily routines, or family responsibilities?

I suppose... yeah. I mean, I still care about my wife and kids. I just... I don't seem to have the push to do much. Like calling my son at college, or... meeting up with that kayak group. Even my little repair projects. I just don't do them. And when they ask what's wrong, I... I mostly just shrug. I can't really find much to say.
When you do end up doing something, like spending time with your family or working on a small project, do you find that it doesn’t bring you any satisfaction or enjoyment anymore?
I... I don't know. Like I said, I'm just not doing much of anything. So... I can't really tell you if I'd enjoy it or not. I'm just not doing it.
When you do end up doing something, like spending time with your family or working on a small project, do you find that it doesn’t bring you any satisfaction or enjoyment anymore?
Didn't you... just ask me that? I don't know what else to tell you. I don't have a different answer for you. I'm just not doing those things right now, so... I really don't know how I'd feel.
Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually energized, overly confident, or irritable for several days at a time, where others around you noticed a change in your behavior?
No... not really. I don't get energized. Just... how I am now, mostly.
